name: EHDSECGRecording
title: ECG recording model
description: The waveform and its acquisition metadata, which the Xt-EHR models do not provide. The metadata are always structured; the samples are carried inline (FHIR SampledData, required for short recordings) or by reference to a native object (long recordings). The time of sample i of a channel, from acquisitionStart, is startOffset + skew + i / samplingFrequency.

element.short: [C] How this signal came to exist
element.definition: Ordered chain of steps, from the acquisition to this representation (e.g. vendor format -> WFDB -> EHDS).
native-digital, converted-lossless, converted-lossy, losslessness-not-documented, computed-from-recording, reconstructed-from-image, reconstructed-from-reduced-leads, synthetic.
Format the signal was converted from.
Converter, digitiser or signal-processing algorithm, and its version.
Link to the source recording(s), e.g. the rhythm strip a median beat was computed from.
50 or 60 Hz.
Does not change the samples; the PDF rendering remains the reference display.
UCUM mm/s (DICOM Waveform Data Display Scale).
UCUM mm/mV, stated only when the displayed channels share the same gain. From DICOM: Absolute Channel Display Scale (003A,0248) divided by Channel Sensitivity (003A,0210).
3 x 4, 3 x 4 with rhythm strip, 6 x 2, 12 x 1, other.
DICOM multiplex group, aECG sequenceSet.
E.g. rhythm, median beat.
UCUM Hz; > 0 (ecg-rec-9).
>= 1. Equals the number of values in each channel's samples.data (ecg-rec-6).
UCUM ms; >= 0; absent means 0. Supports non-simultaneous acquisition (e.g. 3 x 4 leads). The group ends within the recording (ecg-rec-2).
ADC resolution.
Applied to every channel of the group that does not state its own.
high-pass, low-pass, notch, other.
UCUM Hz.
Order, slope, bandwidth, algorithm.
One lead.
MDC MDC_ECG_ELEC_POTL_* codes; required within the set it covers, extensible for non-standard leads.
True if computed from other leads (III, aVR, aVL, aVF usually are).
Formula or method of derivation.

element.short: [C] UCUM unit of the physical values
element.definition: channel.origin and samples.origin use the same unit (ecg-rec-8).
In unit. Always present, also when samples are carried by reference.
Multiplier from stored integer to physical value in unit (e.g. 4.88 uV per LSB). Always present.
ok, disconnected, noisy, saturated, lead-reversal-suspected, questionable, invalid, uncalibrated, unzeroed, test-data.
Offset of the first sample of this channel from the start of the channel group, UCUM ms (DICOM Channel Time Skew or Channel Sample Skew). 0 = simultaneous; absent = not documented, counted as 0.
Filters of this channel, when they differ from those of the group; they replace channelGroup.filter for this channel.
high-pass, low-pass, notch, other.
UCUM Hz.
Order, slope, bandwidth, algorithm.

FHIR R5 SampledData. Required for short recordings (ecg-rec-3). data present with numberOfSamples values; dimensions = 1; interval equals 1 / samplingFrequency; origin and factor equal the channel's (ecg-rec-4 to ecg-rec-7).

element.short: [C] Original object in its native format
element.definition: Optional, in addition to the inline samples for short recordings; the way to carry the samples of long recordings.
The object must be retrievable (ecg-rec-10).
E.g. WFDB .hea + .dat.
The file itself or its URL.
SHA-256 of the file.
12-Lead ECG, General ECG, General 32-bit ECG or Ambulatory ECG SOP instance, retrievable through the imaging infrastructure (IHE MADO).
Where the object can be retrieved, e.g. for long-term recordings.
